feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Man shot by ICE agent isn't getting proper medical care in detention, lawyer says
entry.summary: Three days after ICE agents shot and injured Wilber Rafael Garces Perez in Austin, Texas, questions linger about the details around this enforcement operation.

entry.title: How abuse in some of Tennessee's juvenile prisons remained under wraps
entry.summary: Employees at a group of privately-run juvenile detention facilities across Tennessee failed to report suspected physical and sexual abuse to the state, and were allegedly discouraged from calling 911.

entry.title: HHS cancels health insurance of 760,000 individuals enrolled in healthcare.gov plans
entry.summary: The Department of Health and Human Services announced something it's never done before - canceled the health insurance of 760,000 individuals enrolled in plans in the Affordable Care Act marketplace.

entry.title: Indian American comic explores her Kentucky roots
entry.summary: In her new show, comedian Pooja Reddy busts stereotypes as her youth in rural Kentucky takes center stage.

entry.title: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
entry.summary: The Black Mississippi teen's family questions whether his race contributed to his July 4th death on an island off the Mississippi coast.

entry.title: The United Nations General Assembly is meeting. Is it accomplishing anything?
entry.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Michael Froman, Council on Foreign Relations president, at the UN General Assembly.

entry.title: Baltimore Orioles owner says if you want to be loved, don't buy a sports team
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with David Rubenstein, a Baltimore native, philanthropist and investor who leads an ownership group that acquired the Baltimore Orioles in 2024.

entry.title: Explaining Trump TV — and how it could help or hurt President Trump
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with media consultant and television producer Mark McKinnon about the launching of Trump TV, an official White House Youtube channel, streaming 24/7.

entry.title: Is produce from a home garden safer than store bought? 'It depends'
entry.summary: Home gardening is getting a boost, in part, from fears of foodborne illness. But is homegrown safer? Experts weigh in.

entry.title: Alaska's annual Fat Bear Week kicks off
entry.summary: Bears in Katmai National Park and Preserve in Alaska have been bulking up on salmon before winter. On Tuesday, annual voting kicks off for the favorite.
